    if (els.btnHeat) els.btnHeat.classList.toggle('on', state.showHeat);
    if (els.btnDiff) els.btnDiff.textContent = '难度：' + (DIFF[state.difficulty] || DIFF.normal).label;
    if (els.btnMap) els.btnMap.textContent = '地图：' + (state.mapMode === 'random' ? '随机' : '经典');
    if (els.btnSound) {
      els.btnSound.textContent = state.sound ? '🔊 音效' : '🔇 静音';
      els.btnSound.classList.toggle('on', state.sound);
    }

    if (els.status) {
      if (state.phase === 'over') {
        els.status.textContent = '对局结束 · 点「重开」再来一局';
        els.status.classList.remove('ai');
      } else if (state.phase === 'ai') {
        els.status.textContent = '敌方回合 · AI 正在行动…';
        els.status.classList.add('ai');
      } else if (state.selected && state.selected.alive) {
        els.status.textContent = '第 ' + state.turn + ' 回合 · 已选中' +
          TYPES[state.selected.type].name +
          (state.selected.moved ? '（点红框敌人攻击）' : '（点蓝格移动）');
        els.status.classList.remove('ai');
      } else {
        els.status.textContent = '第 ' + state.turn + ' 回合 · 你的回合，点击蓝色单位';
        els.status.classList.remove('ai');
      }
    }

    renderCoach();
  }

  function renderLog() { refreshUI(); }

  /* ---------------- AI 教练：给玩家的每一步打分 ---------------- */
  function recordReview(unit, gx, gy) {
    const pp = state.playerPlan;
    if (!pp) return;
    const s = pp.heat[key(gx, gy)];
    if (s !== s) return;                       // NaN
    const best = pp.plan;
    state.review.push({
      turn: state.turn, type: unit.type,
      x: gx, y: gy, score: s,
      bx: best.x, by: best.y, bscore: best.score,
      why: best.why
    });
    if (state.review.length > 30) state.review.shift();
  }

  function cellName(x, y) { return 'ABCDEF'[x] + (y + 1); }

  function whyShort(w) {
    if (!w) return '综合评分更高';
    const parts = [];
    if (w.kill) parts.push('可击杀');
    if (w.terr > 0) parts.push('占高地');
    if (w.threat > -6) parts.push('不易被反击');
    if (w.close < 0) parts.push('拉开距离');
    if (!parts.length) parts.push('位置更好');
    return parts.join(' · ');
  }

  function renderCoach() {
    const box = els.coach;
    if (!box) return;
    if (!state.review.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="chint">走几步之后，这里会指出你哪一步亏得最多。</div>';
      return;
    }
    const top = state.review.slice()
      .sort((a, b) => (b.bscore - b.score) - (a.bscore - a.score))
      .filter(r => r.bscore - r.score > 8)
      .slice(0, 3);

    if (!top.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<div class="item good">到目前为止每一步都接近最优，没什么可挑的。</div>';
      return;
    }

    box.innerHTML = top.map(function (r) {
      const d = Math.round(r.bscore - r.score);
      return '<div class="item">第 ' + r.turn + ' 回合 · ' + TYPES[r.type].name +
        ' 走了 <i>' + cellName(r.x, r.y) + '</i>，比最优低 <b>' + d + '</b> 分' +
        '<br>更优：<i>' + cellName(r.bx, r.by) + '</i>（' + whyShort(r.why) + '）</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function buildLegend() {
    const box = $('legend');
    if (!box) return;
    const colors = { sword: '#ffd166', bow: '#5ef2a8', mage: '#9db4ff', cleric: '#ffb3d1' };
    box.innerHTML = ['sword', 'bow', 'mage', 'cleric'].map(function (k) {
      const t = TYPES[k];
      return '<div class="lg"><i style="background:' + colors[k] + '"></i><b>' + t.name +
        '</b> ' + t.hp + '血 · 攻' + t.atk + ' · 射' + t.range + '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function showHelp() {
    if (!els.helpModal) return;
    state.helpOpen = true;
    els.helpModal.classList.remove('hidden');
  }

  function hideHelp() {
    if (!els.helpModal) return;
    state.helpOpen = false;
    els.helpModal.classList.add('hidden');
  }

  /* ==================== 尺寸 ==================== */
  function resize() {
    const cv = els.board;
    if (!cv) return;
    const rect = cv.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const W = Math.max(200, Math.floor(rect.width));
    const H = Math.max(200, Math.floor(rect.height));
    const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    cv.width = Math.round(W * dpr);
    cv.height = Math.round(H * dpr);
    cv.style.width = W + 'px';
    cv.style.height = H + 'px';
    els.ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    view.w = W; view.h = H;
    const pad = 26;
    view.cell = Math.floor(Math.min((W - pad * 2) / N, (H - pad * 2) / N));
    view.cell = Math.max(20, view.cell);
    view.ox = Math.round((W - view.cell * N) / 2);
    view.oy = Math.round((H - view.cell * N) / 2);
  }

  /* ==================== 主循环 ==================== */
  let last = 0;
  const diag = { frames: 0, clicks: 0, error: null };

  function paintDiag() {
    if (!els.diag) return;
    if (diag.error) {
      els.diag.textContent = '⚠ ' + diag.error;
      els.diag.classList.add('err');
    } else {
      els.diag.textContent = '诊断 · 帧 ' + diag.frames + ' · 点击 ' + diag.clicks;
      els.diag.classList.remove('err');
    }
  }

  function loop(ts) {
    try {
      if (!last) last = ts;
      let dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
      last = ts;
      if (dt > 0.2) dt = 0.2;

      if (state.phase === 'ai') {
        state.aiTimer -= dt;
        if (state.aiTimer <= 0) {
          if (state.aiStage === 'act') commitAIUnit();
          else beginAIUnit();
        }
      }

      if (state.phase !== 'ai') {
        els.thinking.classList.remove('show');
      }

      render();
      diag.frames++;
      if (diag.frames % 15 === 0) paintDiag();
    } catch (err) {
      // 单帧出错不再中断整个循环，并暴露到诊断条上
      diag.error = (err && err.message) || String(err);
      paintDiag();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  /* ==================== 交互绑定 ==================== */
  function bindUI() {
    window.addEventListener('error', ev => {
      diag.error = (ev && ev.message) || '脚本错误';
      paintDiag();
    });

    els.board.addEventListener('click', e => {
      diag.clicks++;
      const r = els.board.getBoundingClientRect();
      state.ripples.push({ x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top, t0: nowMs() });
      if (state.ripples.length > 10) state.ripples.shift();

      const gx = Math.floor((e.clientX - r.left - view.ox) / view.cell);
      const gy = Math.floor((e.clientY - r.top - view.oy) / view.cell);
      try {
        handleClick(gx, gy);
      } catch (err) {
        diag.error = (err && err.message) || String(err);
      }
      paintDiag();
    });

    els.btnEnd.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (state.phase !== 'player') return;
      if (state.selected) state.selected.acted = true;
      state.selected = null;
      state.reach = null;
      if (!checkOver()) startAITurn();
    });

    els.btnBait.addEventListener('click', function () {
      state.scenarioIdx = (state.scenarioIdx + 1) % SCENARIOS.length;
      loadScenario(state.scenarioIdx);
      startAITurn();
    });

    els.btnRestart.addEventListener('click', () => newGame());
    els.bannerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => newGame());

    els.btnHeat.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.showHeat = !state.showHeat;
      if (!state.showHeat) state.heat = null;
      refreshUI();
    });

    els.btnDiff.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const i = DIFF_ORDER.indexOf(state.difficulty);
      state.difficulty = DIFF_ORDER[(i + 1) % DIFF_ORDER.length];
      refreshUI();
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-pace]').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.pace = btn.dataset.pace;
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-pace]').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle('on', b === btn);
        });
      });
    });

    els.btnMap.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.mapMode = state.mapMode === 'random' ? 'classic' : 'random';
      newGame();
    });

    els.btnSound.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.sound = !state.sound;
      if (state.sound) SFX.ui();
      refreshUI();
    });

    // AI 性格滑块
    [['aggr', 'p-aggr', 'v-aggr'], ['caution', 'p-caution', 'v-caution'],
     ['focus', 'p-focus', 'v-focus']].forEach(function (cfg) {
      const el = $(cfg[1]), lab = $(cfg[2]);
      if (!el || !lab) return;
      el.value = Math.round(state.personality[cfg[0]] * 100);
      lab.textContent = el.value;
      el.addEventListener('input', function () {
        state.personality[cfg[0]] = parseFloat(el.value) / 100;
        lab.textContent = el.value;
      });
    });

    // 所有按钮的轻点音
    document.addEventListener('click', ev => {
      warmAnnounce();
      if (ev.target && ev.target.tagName === 'BUTTON') SFX.ui();
    });

    els.btnAuto.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.auto = !state.auto;
      els.btnAuto.classList.toggle('on', state.auto);
      els.btnAuto.textContent = state.auto ? '停止观战' : '观战：AI 打 AI';
      if (state.auto) {
        runAutoBattle();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { hideHelp(); hideBait(); return; }
      if (state.helpOpen || state.baitOpen) return;
      if (e.code === 'Space') {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (state.phase === 'player') els.btnEnd.click();
      }
    });

    if (els.btnHelp) els.btnHelp.addEventListener('click', showHelp);
    if (els.btnHelpClose) els.btnHelpClose.addEventListener('click', hideHelp);
    if (els.helpModal) {
      els.helpModal.addEventListener('click', ev => {
        if (ev.target === els.helpModal) hideHelp();
      });
    }

    if (els.btnBaitClose) els.btnBaitClose.addEventListener('click', hideBait);
    if (els.baitModal) {
      els.baitModal.addEventListener('click', ev => {
        if (ev.target === els.baitModal) hideBait();
      });
    }

    let rt = 0;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(rt);
      rt = setTimeout(resize, 100);
    });
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      new ResizeObserver(() => resize()).observe(els.board.parentElement);
    }
  }

  /* ==================== 观战：AI vs AI ==================== */
  function runAutoBattle() {
    if (!state.auto) return;
    if (state.phase === 'over') { newGame(); }
    if (state.phase === 'player') {
      // 玩家方也交给 AI
      const mine = aliveOf('p');
      let done = false;
      for (const u of mine) {
        if (!u.alive) continue;
        const res = planUnit(u, 'p');
        executePlan(u, res.plan);
        if (checkOver()) { done = true; break; }
      }
      if (done) { state.auto = false; return; }
      startAITurn();
      setTimeout(runAutoBattle, 700);
    } else if (state.phase === 'ai') {
      setTimeout(runAutoBattle, 700);
    }
  }

  /* ==================== 启动 ==================== */
  function init() {
    els.board = $('board');
    els.ctx = els.board.getContext('2d');
    els.cTurn = $('c-turn'); els.cP = $('c-p'); els.cA = $('c-a');
    els.unitCard = $('unit-card');
    els.log = $('log');
    els.coach = $('coach');
    els.banner = $('banner');
    els.bannerBig = $('bannerBig');
    els.bannerTitle = $('bannerTitle');
    els.bannerSub = $('bannerSub');
    els.bannerBtn = $('bannerBtn');
    els.thinking = $('thinking');
    els.status = $('status');
    els.diag = $('diag');
    els.btnEnd = $('btnEnd');
    els.btnAuto = $('btnAuto');
    els.btnBait = $('btnBait');
    els.baitModal = $('baitModal');
    els.baitTitle = $('baitTitle');
    els.baitLead = $('baitLead');
    els.baitBody = $('baitBody');
    els.btnBaitClose = $('btnBaitClose');
    els.btnRestart = $('btnRestart');
    els.btnHeat = $('btnHeat');
    els.btnDiff = $('btnDiff');
    els.btnMap = $('btnMap');
    els.btnSound = $('btnSound');
    els.streak = $('streak');
    els.btnHelp = $('btnHelp');
    els.btnHelpClose = $('btnHelpClose');
    els.helpModal = $('helpModal');

    buildLegend();
    resize();
    newGame();
    bindUI();
    refreshUI();
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    showHelp();

    setTimeout(function () {
      if (diag.frames === 0) {
        _fail('渲染循环没启动（init 中途失败）');
      } else if (!diag.error && _diagEl) {
        _diagEl.textContent = '诊断 · 帧 ' + diag.frames + ' · 点击 ' + diag.clicks;
      }
    }, 1500);
  }

  /* ==================== 测试钩子 ==================== */
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.__GAME__ = {
      state: state,
      view: view,
      BASE_W: BASE_W,
      TUNABLE: TUNABLE,
      weightsFor: weightsFor,
      ANNOUNCE_SRC: ANNOUNCE_SRC,
      aiWeights: aiWeights,
      loadScenario: loadScenario,
      SCENARIOS: SCENARIOS,
      evalScenario: evalScenario,
      newGame: newGame,
      generateMap: generateMap,
      endGame: endGame,
      planUnit: planUnit,
      executePlan: executePlan,
      aliveOf: aliveOf,
      startAITurn: startAITurn,
      computeReach: computeReach,
      // 无头模拟：双方都由 AI 操作，返回胜者与回合数
      autoBattle: function (maxTurns) {
        maxTurns = maxTurns || MAX_TURNS;
        let guard = 0;
        while (state.phase !== 'over' && state.turn <= maxTurns && guard++ < 4000) {
          for (const side of ['p', 'a']) {
            for (const u of aliveOf(side)) {
              if (!u.alive) continue;
              const res = planUnit(u, side);
              executePlan(u, res.plan);
              if (state.phase === 'over') break;
            }
            if (state.phase === 'over') break;
            if (aliveOf('p').length === 0) { endGame('a'); return { winner: 'a', turns: state.turn, reason: 'wipe' }; }
            if (aliveOf('a').length === 0) { endGame('p'); return { winner: 'p', turns: state.turn, reason: 'wipe' }; }
          }
          state.turn++;
          for (const u of state.units) u.acted = false;
        }
        if (state.phase !== 'over') {
          const php = aliveOf('p').reduce((s, u) => s + u.hp, 0);
          const ahp = aliveOf('a').reduce((s, u) => s + u.hp, 0);
          const w = php === ahp ? 'p' : (php > ahp ? 'p' : 'a');
          endGame(w, 'hp');
          return { winner: w, turns: state.turn, reason: 'hp', php, ahp };
        }
        return { winner: state.winner, turns: state.turn, reason: 'wipe' };
      }
    };
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.getElementById) {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        try { init(); } catch (e) { _fail('初始化失败: ' + (e && e.message)); }
      });
    } else {
      try { init(); } catch (e) { _fail('初始化失败: ' + (e && e.message)); }
    }
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
